=== Torii collapse due to the earthquake ===
In the early morning of {{ill|April 9|Q2504|qid=Q2504}}, {{ill|2018|ab|2018|af|2018|als|2018|am|2018 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|2018|ar|2018|ary|2018|arz|2018|ast|2018|av|2018 сон|avk|2018|az|2018|azb|۲۰۱۸ (میلادی)|ba|2018 йыл|ban|2018|bar|2018|bat_smg|2018|bcl|2018|be|2018|be_x_old|2018|bg|2018|bh|2018|bjn|2018|bn|২০১৮|bo|༢༠༡༨ལོ།|br|2018|bs|2018.|btm|2018|bxr|2018 он|ca|2018|cbk_zam|2018|cdo|2018 nièng|ceb|2018|ckb|٢٠١٨|co|2018|crh|2018|cs|2018|csb|2018|cv|2018|cy|2018|da|2018|de|2018|diq|2018|dsb|2018|dv|2018|el|2018|eml|2018|eo|2018|es|2018|et|2018|eu|2018|ext|2018|fa|۲۰۱۸|fi|2018|fiu_vro|2018|fo|2018|fr|2018|frp|2018|frr|2018|fur|2018|fy|2018|ga|2018|gag|2018|gan|2018年|gcr|2018|gd|2018|gl|2018|gn|2018|gor|2018|gv|2018|ha|2018|hak|2018-ngièn|he|2018|hi|२०१८|hif|2018|hr|2018.|hsb|2018|hu|2018|hy|2018|ia|2018|id|2018|ie|2018|ilo|2018|inh|2018 шу|io|2018|is|2018|it|2018|ja|2018年|jbo|2018moi|jv|2018|ka|2018|kaa|2018|kab|2018|kk|2018 жыл|kn|೨೦೧೮|ko|2018년|krc|2018 джыл|ku|2018|kv|2018-ӧд во|kw|2018|la|2018|lb|2018|lfn|2018|li|2018|lij|2018|lld|2018|lmo|2018|lo|ຄ.ສ. 2018|lt|2018 m.|lv|2018. gads|mai|२०१८|map_bms|2018|mdf|2018|mi|2018|min|2018|mk|2018|ml|2018|mn|2018 он|mr|इ.स. २०१८|ms|2018|mwl|2018|my|၂၀၁၈|myv|2018 ие|mzn|۲۰۱۸|nah|2018|nap|2018|nds|2018|nds_nl|2018|new|सन् २०१८|nl|2018|nn|2018|no|2018|nrm|2018|nso|2018|oc|2018|olo|2018|os|2018-æм аз|pa|2018|pag|2018|pap|2018|pl|2018|pnb|2018ء|ps|۲۰۱۸|pt|2018|qu|2018|ro|2018|roa_tara|2018|ru|2018 год|rue|2018|sah|2018 сыл|sc|2018|scn|2018|sd|2018ع|se|2018|sh|2018.|shn|2018|si|2018|simple|2018|sk|2018|sl|2018|sm|2018|smn|2018|sn|2018|so|2018|sq|2018|sr|2018|stq|2018|su|2018|sv|2018|sw|2018|szl|2018|ta|2018|tg|Соли 2018|th|พ.ศ. 2561|tk|2018|tl|2018|tly|2018|tr|2018|tt|2018 ел|tyv|2018 чыл|udm|2018 ар|ug|2018 - يىلى|uk|2018|ur|2018ء|uz|2018|vec|2018|vep|2018|vi|2018|vls|2018|vo|2018|wa|2018|war|2018|wuu|2018年|xmf|2018|yi|2018|za|2018 nienz|zea|2018|zgh|2018|zh|2018年|zh_classical|二〇一八年|zh_min_nan|2018 nî|zh_yue|2018年|zu|2018|qid=Q25291}}, an inland, shallow-focus earthquake of magnitude 6.1 occurred in western Shimane Prefecture (the {{ill|2018 Shimane earthquake|ja|島根県西部地震|ko|시마네현 서부 지진|vi|Động đất Shimane 2018|zh|2018年岛根地震|qid=Q52105048}}). A maximum seismic intensity of 5+ was observed in Ōda City near the epicenter, where damage was concentrated<ref>{{PDFlink|[https://ibaraki-saito.sakura.ne.jp/image/20180409simaneotajisinhigai.pdf On the earthquake that occurred in the vicinity of Ōda City, western Shimane Prefecture, in the early morning of April 9, 2018]}}</ref><ref>{{PDFlink|[https://www.city.oda.lg.jp/files/original/20190918150632495a6b32ed8.pdf The Western Shimane Earthquake with an epicenter in eastern Ōda City]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Related information on the earthquake that occurred in western Shimane Prefecture on April 9, 2018 (Heisei 30) |url=https://www.gsj.jp/hazards/earthquake/shimane2018/index.html |website=www.gsj.jp |access-date=2024-12-31 |publisher={{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=AIST}} {{ill|Geological Survey of Japan|Q11424703|qid=Q11424703}} / Geological Survey of Japan, AIST}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Earthquake: intensity 5+ in Shimane; five people injured; building damage |url=https://mainichi.jp/articles/20180409/k00/00e/040/152000c |website= |access-date=2024-12-31 |language=ja |publisher={{ill|Mainichi Shimbun|Q1136866|qid=Q1136866}} |date=2018/4/9}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Earthquake with intensity 5+ in Shimane; four injured in Ōda City |url=https://www.risktaisaku.com/articles/-/5672 |website= |access-date=2024-12-31 |publisher=Risk Taisaku.com |date=2018/04/09}}</ref>. As a result of this earthquake, the {{ill|Torii|Q234731|qid=Q234731}} gate within the grounds of Karita Shrine collapsed into pieces, blocking the roadway<ref name=":2" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=[Shimane Earthquake] “A roaring sound rang out and everything in the house fell over”—cracks in roads, torii collapse; water supply difficulties in Ōda City |url=https://www.sankei.com/article/20180409-Q6VDKOQUQRKTJD3YCNXFQTUE5U/ |website= |date=2018-04-09 |access-date=2024-12-31 |language=ja |publisher={{ill|Sankei Shimbun|Q1197261|qid=Q1197261}}}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Shimane Prefecture western area hit by intensity 5+ earthquake; no tsunami concern |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180409102417/https://www.asahi.com/articles/photo/AS20180409000151.html |website=web.archive.org |date=2018-04-09 |access-date=2024-12-31 |publisher={{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Asahi Shimbun Digital}}}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Earthquake: intensity 5+ in western Shimane Prefecture; no tsunami concern |url=https://mainichi.jp/graphs/20180409/hpj/00m/040/002000g/20180409hpj00m040022000q |website= |access-date=2024-12-31 |language=ja |publisher={{ill|Mainichi Shimbun|Q1136866|qid=Q1136866}} |date=2018/4/9}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=[Photo Gallery][Shimane Earthquake] Five injured, water outages at 108 households; Chief Cabinet Secretary Yoshihide Suga: “Remain vigilant” |url=https://www.sankei.com/gallery/20180409-W4LP5V454FLQVEXZ5HHBGCNWCI/ |website= |date=2018/4/9 |access-date=2024-12-31 |language=ja |publisher={{ill|Sankei Shimbun|Q1197261|qid=Q1197261}}}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{PDFlink|[https://peshimane.net/wp/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/2018-01_%E5%B3%B6%E6%A0%B9%E7%9C%8C%E8%A5%BF%E9%83%A8%E5%9C%B0%E9%9C%87%E3%82%92%E6%8C%AF%E3%82%8A%E8%BF%94%E3%82%8B%EF%BC%88%E5%9D%82%E7%94%B0%E8%81%96%E4%BA%8C%E3%80%81%E6%9C%88%E6%A3%AE%E5%8B%9D%E5%8D%9A%E3%80%81%E7%95%91%E5%92%8C%E5%AE%8F%E3%80%81%E4%BA%95%E4%B8%8A%E7%9C%9F%EF%BC%89.pdf Looking back on the Western Shimane Earthquake]}}</ref><ref name=":4">{{PDFlink|[https://anzen.eng.tottori-u.ac.jp/wp-content/uploads/sites/6/2018/05/67e369bffc4f354f3e7862199ea2c25d.pdf Investigation report on the earthquake in western Shimane Prefecture on April 9, 2018]}}</ref><ref>{{PDFlink|[https://isss.jp.net/isss-site/wp-content/uploads/2018/04/2018_shimane_seibu_eq_mori-20180419presented.pdf Preliminary briefing on on-site damage investigation of the Western Shimane Earthquake on April 9, 2018]}}</ref>. Kute-chō and Hane-chō in Ōda City—including the Hanenishi district where Karita Shrine is located—were among the areas that suffered particularly severe damage in this earthquake<ref name=":4" />. In addition to the presence of {{ill|Lake Hane|Q55523943|qid=Q55523943}} and the Kute reclaimed land, liquefaction damage is also thought to have occurred due to the distribution of {{ill|Holocene|Q25445|qid=Q25445}} sedimentary layers near the {{ill|Sea of Japan|Q27092|qid=Q27092}} in this region<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":4" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=Geology and earthquakes of the Ōda region—Learning from the 2018 Western Shimane (Ōda) Earthquake— |url=https://sanbesan.web.fc2.com/kouza_shiryou/kouza_ohda_180515.html |website=sanbesan.web.fc2.com |access-date=2024-12-31 |date=May 15, 2018}}</ref>.
